entities.summary: Ryan Glenn is a Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman who has played for several teams in Europe. He was selected by the Montreal Canadiens in the 5th round of the 2000 NHL Entry Draft. After playing his second season in the EBEL in 2016–17 with HC Bolzano, Glenn left as a free agent to continue in the league on a one-year deal with EC VSV on May 2, 2017.
